title: Tasmota Feed Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Zigbee2MQTT device reports (`zigbee2mqtt:device`), Shelly/Tasmota telemetry (`shelly:status`, `tasmota:sensor`), Hue bridge events (`hue:event`), Nest/Ecobee thermostat (`ecobee:thermostat`), door/leak/motion sensors.
app: Philips Hue, smart plugs (Tasmota/Shelly/TP-Link Kasa), thermostats (Nest/Ecobee), locks, and Zigbee/Z-Wave sensors via MQTT / Zigbee2MQTT and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tasmota:sensor
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for tasmota data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate tasmota events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It will rank how your tasmota activity added up each month instead of day by day.
